name: Solar Installation Checklist
html:

Details of Installation and Checklist to be furnished along with the request for Testing of Solar Inverters

2Name of Electrical Section{{ v.get("electrical_section", "") | e }}
3Consumer Number{{ v.get("consumer_number", "") | e }}
4Tariff{{ v.get("tariff", "") | e }}
5Connected Load{{ v.get("connected_load", "") | e }}
6Name of the solar plant owner{{ v.get("solar_plant_owner", "") | e }}
7Address{{ v.get("address", "") | e }}
8e-mail ID{{ v.get("email_id", "") | e }}
9Contact Number of Consumer{{ v.get("consumer_contact_number", "") | e }}

Account Number		{{ v.get("bank_name", "") | e }}

Plant Details
1Type of Plant{{ v.get("plant_type", "") | e }}
2Total Capacity of Solar Plant{{ v.get("plant_total_capacity", "") | e }}
3Number of Plant{{ v.get("plant_number", "") | e }}
3.aIndividual Capacity{{ v.get("plant_individual_capacity", "") | e }}
4Make and Serial Number of Inverter{{ v.get("inverter_make_and_serial_number", "") | e }}
4.aInverter Type{{ v.get("inverter_type", "") | e }}
4.bInverter Capacity{{ v.get("inverter_capacity", "") | e }}
5DC Output Voltage{{ v.get("dc_output_voltage", "") | e }}
6Make and Total number of PV Installations{{ v.get("pv_installations_make_and_total_number", "") | e }}
7Voltage and Number of Phase{{ v.get("voltage_and_number_of_phase", "") | e }}
8If the inverter is of hybrid type, whether the scheme confirms to the scheme approved by CE(REES){{ v.get("hybrid_scheme_conforms_to_ce_rees", "") | e }}
9Whether the completion certificate submitted to the section{{ v.get("completion_certificate_submitted", "") | e }}
10Whether the Energisation approval obtained from EB{{ v.get("energisation_approval_obtained_from_eb", "") | e }}
11Whether the Energisation approved by EB{{ v.get("energisation_approved_by_eb", "") | e }}
12Whether DC isolator provided on incoming side of the inverter{{ v.get("dc_isolator_provided", "") | e }}
13Whether visual isolator provided on before connectivity point{{ v.get("visual_isolator_provided", "") | e }}
14Whether all wiring connections as per the approved scheme are completed{{ v.get("wiring_connections_completed", "") | e }}
15Whether the earthing provided for installation as per the standards(Earthing for ACDB, DCDB, Isolator, Body of Inverter, Structure and Panels Lightening arrester){{ v.get("earthing_as_per_standards", "") | e }}
15.aResistance for all the installation{{ v.get("installation_resistance", "") | e }}
15.bConductor and Earthing{{ v.get("conductor_and_earthing_resistance", "") | e }}
15.cBetween conductor{{ v.get("between_conductor_resistance", "") | e }}
15.dElectrodes of earthing system{{ v.get("earthing_electrodes_resistance", "") | e }}
16Whether the inverter is provided with following protection functions?{{ v.get("inverter_protection_functions_voltage", "") | e }}
16.aWhether over voltage and Under voltage trip function provided in the inverter{{ v.get("over_under_voltage_trip_provided", "") | e }}
16.bDetails of settings provided in the inverterOver Voltage setting{{ v.get("inverter_over_voltage_setting", "") | e }}
16.cUnder Voltage Setting{{ v.get("inverter_under_voltage_setting", "") | e }}
16.dTrip Time Setting{{ v.get("inverter_voltage_trip_time", "") | e }}
16.eWhether the inverter is provided with following protection functions?{{ v.get("inverter_protection_functions_frequency", "") | e }}
16.fDetails of settings provided in the inverterOver frequency setting{{ v.get("inverter_over_frequency_setting", "") | e }}
16.gUnder frequency Setting{{ v.get("inverter_under_frequency_setting", "") | e }}
16.hTrip Time Setting{{ v.get("inverter_frequency_trip_time", "") | e }}
16.iWhether the protection against unidirectional isolating is provided{{ v.get("unidirectional_isolating_protection", "") | e }}
17Grid failure trip Delay{{ v.get("grid_failure_trip_delay", "") | e }}
18Whether Time-Delay function for re-energisation after resuming stable grid supply provided{{ v.get("re_energisation_time_delay_provided", "") | e }}
19Details of re-generating time delay setting{{ v.get("re_generating_time_delay_setting", "") | e }}
The supplier/installer shall provide any of the following in proof of setting provided in the inverter for protection function 14(a) & 14(b) listed above

iActual setting provided in the inverter, as displayed in the HMI of the inverter or downloaded into a laptop PC/mobile phone which is connected to the device

iiFactory Test Certificate issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer or a NABL Accredited LAB showing the serial number of the inverter & protection function setting provided

iiiReport On site Testing carried out at site by an authorised testing agency with a calibrated test kit; witnessed by KSEB

All the statements furnished above are true and correct
